payload.title: R4: Simulated-stakeholder design and offline fake (quote-validated, UNEXPLAINABLE, noisy/shuffled)
payload.description:
## Purpose

Design the simulated stakeholder and build its offline fake. Dataset-agnostic; can proceed after R0 in parallel with screening.

## Design

- **Sees:** the item text, Jev's verdict, the gold label, and the full guideline (not the excerpt limit of F if it fits the stakeholder model's context).
- **Outputs:** one sentence "should be G because [rule]" + rule ID (section/rule identifier in the guideline) + a verbatim guideline quote <= 30 words, validated by exact string match against the guideline text (after whitespace normalization); reject on mismatch.
- **Rejects:** explanations that only restate the label, and text-specific claims that are not a rule (validator + prompt instruction).
- **May answer UNEXPLAINABLE:** logged as a label-noise estimate, NOT fed forward to the analyst.
- **Model:** a different model family from Jev and from the analyst (owner to confirm the model before R6).
- **Per round:** 10-20 errors, from the pool only; cap repeats per rule ID (e.g. <= 3 per round) so one rule cannot dominate.
- **Noisy variant:** ~20% of explanations replaced by vague ("seems off") or wrong-rule explanations, seeded and logged.
- **Shuffled variant:** explanations permuted across items (each attached to a wrong item), seeded.

## Specs (first, beside the module)

prompt contains item, verdict, gold, guideline; quote validator accepts verbatim and rejects paraphrase; restated-label and text-specific outputs rejected; UNEXPLAINABLE logged and not forwarded; per-rule repeat cap enforced; noisy and shuffled variants deterministic for a seed; offline fake produces valid outputs from a tiny fixture guideline.

## Reuse

`unified_labeler.py` (`labeler_prompt`, `wants_comment`) and the Emotion S5 design (decision-flywheel-evaluations-5e9ab3cf-fecc-4fda-9ea4-d3dfe2f003c1).

## Definition of done

Specs pass offline under `make test`; design note committed; Sonnet agent builds, main session reviews.

## Cost

$0 (offline, no network).
